notes: Original experimental paper (Microporous Mesoporous Mater. 2015, DiVA postprint). H2 uptake measured gravimetrically (Rubotherm) at 293 K up to 120 bar and volumetrically (Hiden IMI) at 293 K and 77 K up to 50 bar. Sorbents are thermally exfoliated and KOH-activated reduced graphite oxide plus a reference activated carbon, all carbon-majority. BET surface area is given per sample in Figures 2 to 5 (axes and curve labels) and in text (Section 3.1). record.json is_retracted is false and no retraction notice appears in the text. The paper does not state that all its H2 uptake values were published before (Figure 2 adds MOF-5 and Pt/AC points from an earlier study only as references), so duplicate_data does not apply. Supplementary data (XPS and Raman) are referenced but not supplied in the input; they do not bear on I1 to I5. Figure 4 caption: '77K using immersion thermostat', isotherms to 50 bar.
